description: Sydney cycling map is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Sydney. More and more Sydneysiders are turning to 2 wheels to commute to work, stay fit, reduce travelling times or just for fun. This app contains existing, rideable bicycle routes by path type in our local area. It has been digitised from the 2017 Sydney Cycling Guide and Maps (hard copy publication). Coverage: City of Sydney. The portal files it under the publisher City of Sydney. Its tags are City of Sydney, asset amenity, bike, culture leisure sport, cycling. The portal shows 2026-06-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
